children.name: Gymnoris
children.description: The bush sparrows or rock sparrows, a group of four Afrotropical and Asian species. They are medium-sized sparrows with relatively long tails and pale bills. Males typically have a yellow throat patch, especially conspicuous during the breeding season.

children.name: Gymnoris pyrgita
children.description:
The yellow-spotted bush sparrow or yellow-spotted petronia (Gymnoris pyrgita) is a species of bird in the sparrow family, Passeridae.
It is common throughout the Sahel and the Horn of Africa. Its natural habitats are dry savannah and subtropical or tropical dry lowland grassland.

children.name: Gymnoris superciliaris
children.description: The yellow-throated bush sparrow (Gymnoris superciliaris), also known as the yellow-throated petronia, is a species of bird in the sparrow family Passeridae. It is found in south-central and southern Africa in its natural habitats of subtropical or tropical dry forests, dry savanna, and subtropical or tropical dry shrubland.

children.name: Gymnoris dentata
children.description: The Sahel bush sparrow (Gymnoris dentata) or bush petronia, is a species of bird in the family Passeridae. It is found in Africa from Mauritania to Guinea and east to Eritrea and the south-western Arabian Peninsula in its natural habitats of dry savanna and subtropical or tropical dry shrubland.

children.name: Gymnoris xanthocollis
children.description: The yellow-throated sparrow or chestnut-shouldered petronia (Gymnoris xanthocollis) is a species of sparrow found in southern Asia. It is a species mostly of the dry savannah. They forage on the ground for grain and for berries in bushes. They are often seen perched atop bare branches on trees while calling.

children.name: Petronia
children.description: The Rock Sparrow is the sole member of this genus, a sturdy, streaked bird of rocky hillsides and open stony terrain across southern Europe, North Africa, and Asia. It has a pale bill and a distinctive yellow patch on the breast that is often hard to see.

children.name: Petronia petronia
children.description: The rock sparrow or rock petronia (Petronia petronia) is a small passerine bird in the sparrow family Passeridae.

children.name: Petronia xanthocollis
children.description: Petronia xanthocollis (Chestnut-shouldered Petronia) is a passeridae species found in its native region.

children.name: Carpospiza
children.description: The Pale Rockfinch is the only species in this genus, a pale, finch-like bird of arid rocky hillsides. It has a thin bill compared to other sparrows and a soft, lark-like song. It breeds from Turkey east to Afghanistan and winters in northeastern Africa.

children.name: Carpospiza brachydactyla
children.description: The pale rockfinch or pale rock sparrow (Carpospiza brachydactyla) is a small sparrow found in the Middle East and Central Asia.

children.name: Hypocryptadius
children.description: The Cinnamon Ibon is an enigmatic passerine endemic to the mountains of Mindanao in the Philippines. Long considered a white-eye, molecular studies have firmly placed it within Passeridae as the most basal sparrow lineage. It forages in forest canopies for insects and fruit.

children.name: Hypocryptadius cinnamomeus
children.description: The cinnamon ibon (Hypocryptadius cinnamomeus) is a species of bird endemic to the mountains of Mindanao in the Philippines.

children.name: Montifringilla
children.description: The snowfinches — sturdy, pale-bodied birds of high-altitude plateaus and mountain slopes. They are well-adapted to cold environments with extensive white in the wings and tail that is flashed in flight. They occur across the high mountains of southern Europe, Central Asia, and the Tibetan Plateau.

children.name: Montifringilla nivalis
children.description: The white-winged snowfinch (Montifringilla nivalis) is a small passerine bird. Despite its name, it is a sparrow rather than a true finch.

children.name: Montifringilla adamsi
children.description:
The black-winged snowfinch or Adams's snowfinch (Montifringilla adamsi), is a species of bird in the sparrow family.
It is found in China, India, Nepal, and Pakistan. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical dry shrubland. It is commonly resident in the Tibetan plateau region of north-western Nepal, where it spends the summer at elevations of and the winter, on open stony hillsides, on plateau and near villages.

children.name: Onychostruthus
children.description: The White-rumped Snowfinch is the sole species in this genus, distinguished from Montifringilla by its white rump and unique tail feather structure. It is a high-altitude specialist of the Tibetan Plateau, well-camouflaged against the rocky scree it inhabits.

children.name: Onychostruthus taczanowskii
children.description: The white-rumped snowfinch (Onychostruthus taczanowskii) is a species of passerine bird in the sparrow family Passeridae. It is the only member of the genus Onychostruthus. It is sometimes placed in the genus Montifringilla. It is found in Tibet and central-northern China. Its natural habitats are rocky areas in mountainous regions.

children.name: Pyrgilauda
children.description: The ground snowfinches — four small, pale snowfinch species that inhabit the high-altitude steppes and rocky slopes of Central Asia and the Tibetan Plateau. They are more terrestrial than Montifringilla and have less white in the wings. Named after the Greek pyrgos (tower) and lauda (lark), reflecting their ground-dwelling habits.

children.name: Pyrgilauda theresae
children.description: The Afghan snowfinch (Pyrgilauda theresae) or the Afghan ground-sparrow, bar-tailed snowfinch, Meinertzhagen's snowfinch, or Theresa's snowfinch, is a passerine bird of the sparrow family Passeridae, endemic to the northern parts of the Hindu Kush mountains in Afghanistan.

children.name: Pyrgilauda davidiana
children.description:
Père David's snowfinch (Pyrgilauda davidiana), also known as the small snowfinch, is a species of bird in the sparrow family.
It is found in Mongolia, southern Siberia and northern China. Its natural habitat is temperate grassland.

children.name: Pyrgilauda blanfordi
children.description:
Blanford's snowfinch (Pyrgilauda blanfordi) or the plain-backed snowfinch, is a species of bird in the sparrow family.
It is found in China, India, Nepal, and Pakistan. Its natural habitat is temperate grassland.
